title: Staging environment pilot: run provision-to-ready automation on an internal staging pool
creator: Vanessa Ortiz
project: Provision-to-ready automation sprint (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management)
description:
Goal
Run the new provision-to-ready automation end-to-end on an internal staging Dedicated pool to validate idempotency, stage transitions, readiness gating, and operator UX before attempting a customer expansion. Capture failure modes and refine runbooks/alerts.

Staging target
- Pool: stg-dedicated-aurora (internal)
- Regions/SKUs: us-east-1 (L40S), us-west-2 (A10) (we expect heterogeneity to surface assumptions)
- Control plane env: staging
- Feature flag: provisioning_pipeline_v2 (staging-only)

Acceptance criteria
- At least 2 successful end-to-end runs (new pool bring-up OR expansion) with:
  - state machine transitions recorded and queryable (Requested → Provisioning → Imaging → Bootstrapping → Validating → Ready)
  - readiness gates pass (GPU health + network/DNS/TLS + runtime smoke + perf-canary readiness suite)
  - time-to-ready metric emitted with stage breakdown (events correlate via provisioning_run_id)
- At least 2 failure injections or real failures captured with:
  - clear operator-visible error message + suggested next step
  - runbook updated with reproduction and mitigation
  - rerun semantics validated (re-run a single stage safely, no duplicate resources)

Run plan
1) Pre-flight
- Confirm Terraform variables for staging: networking/IAM defaults + quotas
- Confirm golden image version pinned for this pilot (gpu-node-image@2026.02.0-stg)
- Confirm runtime chart pinned (helm chart runtime-1.18.2-stg) and bootstrap hooks enabled
- Confirm alerts are ticket-only in staging (no paging) but still fire

2) Execute pilot runs
- Use operator CLI:
  - dry-run to validate inputs
  - provision run trigger
  - observe Slack bot updates in #eng-infra (stage start/finish + duration + link to run status)
- Record:
  - timestamps per stage
  - failures + classification
  - whether manual intervention was required (pause/resume)

3) Post-run
- Backfill notes into runbooks:
  - dedicated-pool-provisioning-runbook
  - control-plane-ready-state-troubleshooting
  - image-build-and-rollout-runbook (if imaging issues)
- Open follow-ups as separate issues if changes are non-trivial (don’t expand scope here)

Execution log (summary)
Run 1 (2026-02-05)
- Outcome: Failed in Provisioning (Terraform apply)
- Root cause: missing IAM permission for staging role when creating target group attachment (matches INT-1044)
- Mitigation: platform/infra updated IAM policy; reran Provisioning stage successfully after fix
- Runbook update: Added “staging IAM gotchas” section and pointer to internal-support workflow

Run 2 (2026-02-08)
- Outcome: Failed in Imaging (timeout)
- Root cause: image artifact mirror slow in us-west-2 for A10 nodes (similar to earlier #eng-infra thread)
- Mitigation: switched to alternate mirror; added retry/backoff config; re-run Imaging only
- Runbook update: Added “Imaging timeout / mirror fallback” troubleshooting and how to validate mirror health

Run 3 (2026-02-11)
- Outcome: Failed in Bootstrapping (helm values)
- Root cause: misconfigured helm values caused bootstrap job to hang; stage stuck >45m
- Mitigation: pause run, fix values in staging config, resume; added better error classification for “helm apply hang”
- Runbook update: Added step-by-step for identifying stuck helm hooks + which logs to collect

Run 4 (2026-02-13)
- Outcome: Success (Ready)
- Time-to-ready: 2h 47m (pinned in notes as “first clean run”) 
- Observations:
  - perf-canary readiness suite ran 6m 12s, produced pass/fail JSON, thresholds were reasonable
  - routing correctly ignored pool until Ready (validated by checking advertised capacity = 0 during Validating)
  - stage duration breakdown exported and matched logs within ~30s

Key issues found + fixes (linked)
- IAM permission gap in staging (tracked as INT-1044; fix landed via infra policy change)
- Imaging timeouts on one region/SKU → retry/backoff + mirror fallback guidance (see PR-48241)
- Operator errors were too generic (“bootstrap failed”) → improved error messages + runbook pointers (see PR-48242)
- Stuck stage detection: dashboard alert fired as expected after 30m in Bootstrapping; in staging it created a ticket (no page)

Runbook changes required (completed in this ticket)
- Added “Pilot checklist” section (pre-flight + success criteria)
- Added “When to pause/resume vs re-run stage” decision table
- Added “Common staging-only failures” appendix (IAM, quotas, mirror)
- Added log bundle checklist for escalation to oncall/SRE

Open follow-ups (new issues to file if not already tracked)
- Consider automating mirror selection/pre-warm for known slow regions/SKUs (ties to ENG-2757)
- Add a one-liner in CLI output with the exact dashboard deep link (if not already covered by CLI PR)
- Expand failure classification taxonomy for helm hook timeouts vs image pull issues

Artifacts / references
- Slack: #eng-infra sprint pilot coordination + stage updates
- Internal support: INT-1044 (staging IAM)
- PRs: PR-48241 (retry/backoff), PR-48242 (operator errors), PR-48244 (staging feature flag)

Definition of done
- Pilot runs executed; at least one clean Ready run achieved
- Failures documented with mitigations and runbook updates
- Hand-off note posted in #eng-infra with final time-to-ready + known remaining sharp edges
